title: The Confession of Saint Alder's
author: Dominic Dunmore
blurb: Dominic Iversen, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent twenty years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do before the tide gives up what it took.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
